_doc: Hand-written role of every slice / collection that touched calib documents (mkledger.py joins it with the goldens). role: train (weights fitted to the tokens; never verify for that line), fit-hessian (second-order stats with many parameters per layer), fit-diag (per-row diagonal stats), fit (proxy / knapsack calibration, smooth few-parameter fits), select (accept/reject or best-of picks judged on it), monitor (validation curve, reused often), check (a handful of before/after reads), final (one read of fixed finalists). decisions: rough number of choices judged on it (null = not a decision slice). line: the model line it can bias (all = every quant, including turboderp's). Proxy lines (proxy-2b, proxy-08): Qwen3.5 small-model work on the 4070; they bias only proxy decisions, but method choices made there carry to the 27B. The 0.8B YAQA collection (#33-08) read xcorp, not calib: no ledger line.

golden-calA.note: hproxy calibration, kfit / knapsack refits, early A/B

golden-calBbig.note: larger calB for V1 / V2 comparisons

golden-ver1.note: w- tags: best-measured mixes, validation curve

golden-ver2.note: V2 final pick among finalists (finalsel / vpick)

golden-long2-c*.note: KV-cap sweep of the same 2 traces

golden-ver3.note: V3 monitor (lightly used docs); count decisions as they happen

@hessians-calib.note: challenge-published input Hessians: sum x x^T over every calib token; every quant (ours, turboderp's) fits to them. Biases all arms alike; absolute KLDs slightly optimistic

@yaqa.note: YAQA collections (rows32, hout32, full32, full64, pilots, noise): first 200 windows of the seed-0 shuffle of 2048-token qad windows (pools.json); YAQA dropped, no shipped quant used them

@headsens.note: headsens.npz qad-pool Fisher diagonal (pools.json qad docs, all positions): ranks the slab head's rows

g2b-fit1.note: 2B proxy pipeline checks on the 4070: bf16 vs fp32 halves (#60-01), kernel paths, score check vs score.py

g08-fit1.note: 0.8B golden gate (pipeline check), same docs as g2b-fit1

g2b-search1.note: 2B screening slice: calibration study (proxy2b/CALIBRATION.md, #60-04); count decisions as they happen

g08-search1.note: 0.8B screening slice: YAQA Sketch B arms (#33-08), same docs as g2b-search1

@h2b-calib.note: 2B input Hessians, sum x x^T over every calib token (long docs as independent 8k windows), for the 2B proxy quants

@h08-calib.note: 0.8B input Hessians, sum x x^T over every calib token, for the 0.8B proxy quants

golden-agent-search32.note: search-pool traces ripgrep + cobra as 18 turn-aligned chunks of <= 32k tokens (system header unscored; eval/traces, w67): search accept/reject and its long-context guard; first readout 2026-11-07 report-only

golden-agent-verify32.note: verify-pool traces rich + express as 18 turn-aligned chunks of <= 32k tokens (eval/traces, w67): routine checks of finished mixes only, never iterated against

golden-agent-verify-whole.note: rich + express whole, cut from the published calib golden (eval/traces, w67): rare 200k+ 'does anything break' check on finished mixes; never a selection or tuning target; reported with agent-verify32, never alone

golden-search27b-c.note: #117 (w84, 2026-11-08): calib part of the two-part 27B search slice golden-search27b (36 search-pool docs, cap 8192, seed 20261108, none from golden-search27); its xcorp part reads no calib

golden-search27.note: 27B search slice (103 search-pool docs, 8k cap, seed 27, cut from the published calib golden; gpubox /data/swap27/golden-search27, first use 2026-11-04 #33-28). Decided every 27B pair 11-04..11-08: #33-28 H_out (K2.5 / K4; adopted at every level), #104 swj (K2.5, on H_out, K4), C9, #105 writers asym (null), cdhout27 tile CD on H_out (K4, no harm), #34-02 headwm (v4, h4-u5 scored). Retired for decisions 2026-11-08 6:35 AM CST (overfit audit); report-only since (#117 w84). Added by w90 (merge 11-08 A5)

golden-verify27.note: 27B verify slice (71 verify-pool docs, cut from the published calib golden; gpubox /data/verify27/golden-verify27, w59, first use 2026-11-06 #104 amendment 2). Routine before/after checks of adopted settings: swj K2.5 (0.935 / 0.932), C9 (keeps 0.96 of its gain), H_out K4 seed 0 (0.965), K2.5 H_out arms (#33-28, w84 item 3, 11-08). 5 routine uses by 2026-11-08: spent, no further use (finished V3 mixes get a fresh verify slice). Added by w90 (merge 11-08 A5)
